name: knowledge_delete
description: Delete a document from z-agent-knowledge by its numeric id. Use this when a lesson is no longer valid, contains sensitive information, or was ingested by mistake. Returns success status. WARNING: this is a hard delete — the document AND its embeddings are removed permanently. For 'soft invalidation', prefer to update the document via knowledge_ingest with a new content. Requires the caller to have z-ctc 'knowledge:write' permission (FEATURE025).

id.description: Numeric document id returned by knowledge_ingest or knowledge_list.
